subject.title: fix: wire tailscale_authkey and set operator for serve mode

question: Should the installer preserve an existing Tailscale `OperatorUser` by default rather than replacing it with the OpenClaw service account?
rationale: Changing the operator changes a host-level Tailnet authorization choice; source inspection cannot establish that overwriting an administrator-selected operator is the intended security policy.

options.title: Preserve existing operator
options.body: Only set `openclaw` when `OperatorUser` is empty, and leave an existing value unchanged by default.

options.title: Require explicit override
options.body: Add a narrowly documented opt-in setting for installations that intentionally want the role to replace an existing operator.

options.title: Adopt unconditional replacement
options.body: Keep the present behavior only if maintainers explicitly choose `openclaw` as the required operator on every managed host.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing operator
recommendation.body: Only set `openclaw` when `OperatorUser` is empty, and leave an existing value unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior task-layout work is the closest available current-main ownership signal for this install-path security decision.
